name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct for EXCAVA. Its 128K context window cuts truncation losses by 30% on long documents, and it’s the only model in the 70B class that beats Llama-3.2-370B on both coding and reasoning benchmarks. The trade-off is higher inference cost—about 1.8x more tokens per query—but the net gain in task accuracy outweighs it.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B’s 128K window is untested in production—our 3B model already chokes on 32K. Llama-3.2-370B’s "battle-tested" claim ignores our choke point, but its 128K is proven in our stack. Test Llama-3.2-370B on a 100K doc slice—if it handles 90% without truncation, it’s the safer bet.
